craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of the sealed proof — utsāha as each consequence collapses and the maker stands. Longed-for-One vs nature-run change; pāṭhāntara stable per UNC. Rejected: (a) picking variant → killed: sense stable. Read aloud: FROM-change, ALL-spir-ITS LONG … RUNS-by-NA-ture-ON.

lines: From change, all spirits long for that changeless One;
yet body's change, earth's change, runs by nature on.
l4.sanskrit_cite: pariṇāmāt tad ekaṃ hi sarvān puṃsaḥ pratīṣyate

reads_against.argmap: Desired by all — yet whose change? → The grant (all desire the One) pressed by the body-case.
c1_essence: The svabhāva-view's consequences pressed: desired-by-all yet body-changes by nature; occurrence without union; needlessness fitting neither spirit nor mind; no reunion yet rebirth; mokṣa collapsed into nature; compassion-acts forcing passion-exhaustion doctrine (vv46-51).
The siddhānta sealed: nature-view abandoned as unjust, bodies famously sentient-maker-prior, arrangement-difference the flawless proof, the hetu aimed at Parameśvara unshaken (vv52-54).
